specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: [STU-ARC-002] `handshake_core` MUST NOT gain Studio GPU/compute implementation dependencies. GPU, CPU render, raster, vector, layout, text, color, RAW, sequence, audio, motion, composition and import/export providers MUST be independently selectable crates behind typed `Send + Sync` ports. The existing RasterEngine, VectorEngine, LayoutEngine, TextEngine, ColorEngine and RenderEngine contract semantics remain preserved; new domain ports MUST be specified in canonical contracts before implementation. Contract/document crates MUST NOT depend on provider implementations, kernel, native shell, database, GPU or codec runtimes. No mandatory all-engine dependency facade is permitted.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-ARC-002] `handshake_core`'s `Cargo.toml` MUST NOT gain `wgpu`, WGSL, or GPU-compute dependencies for Studio. All GPU/compute code is isolated in the `studio-engine` workspace crate and reached through the `RasterEngine`/`VectorEngine`/`LayoutEngine`/`TextEngine`/`ColorEngine`/`RenderEngine: Send + Sync` trait boundaries defined in `studio-engine/src/lib.rs` (mirrors [TAI-OVR-009]).

family_scope_citations.note: Family-scope citation. The contract spans this whole clause family; it does not cite one clause.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.

preserved_original.byte_identity_rule: git_baseline is canonical committed byte identity; legacy raw/OID aliases describe working-copy capture only.

authority_migration.legacy_acceptance_policy: Exact old ID/text/scope/proof is retained history and mandatory semantic/production acceptance; old paths, commands and topology never grant active writes.

all_foundations_barrier.condition: Every declared real capability and negative path independently passed before feature dispatch

scope_basis.heading: ## 14.2 Architecture: Kernel Binding and Engine Crates
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-ARC-002] `handshake_core` MUST NOT gain Studio GPU/compute implementation dependencies. GPU, CPU render, raster, vector, layout, text, color, RAW, sequence, audio, motion, composition and import/export providers MUST be independently selectable crates behind typed `Send + Sync` ports. The existing RasterEngine, VectorEngine, LayoutEngine, TextEngine, ColorEngine and RenderEngine contract semantics remain preserved; new domain ports MUST be specified in canonical contracts before implementation. Contract/document crates MUST NOT depend on provider implementations, kernel, native shell, database, GPU or codec runtimes. No mandatory all-engine dependency facade is permitted.
